来源版本：2

时间说明：当前目录；观测日期 2026-10-12
正文片段：
报表名称：销售报表
用途：销售订单台账：按订单统计金额与派单状态
字段定义：[{"name":"reportId","type":"string","description":"报表稳定标识"},{"name":"reportName","type":"string","description":"报表名称"},{"name":"companyCode","type":"string","description":"所属公司代码"},{"name":"docNo","type":"string","description":"来源单据号"},{"name":"amount","type":"decimal","description":"来源金额，币种见 currency；空值表示未提供"},{"name":"currency","type":"string","description":"来源声明币种；空值表示未声明，不能跨币种合计"},{"name":"date","type":"date","description":"业务日期；空值表示未配置"},{"name":"status","type":"string","description":"报表派单状态：未派单/已派单"},{"name":"orderNo","type":"string","description":"订单号"},{"name":"productName","type":"string","description":"产品名称"},{"name":"saleDate","type":"date","description":"销售日期，字符串 yyyy-MM-dd"},{"name":"daysSinceSale","type":"long","description":"距销售日期的天数（派生）"},{"name":"dispatched","type":"boolean","description":"来源记录是否已派单；true为已派单，false为未派单，不代表满足派单规则"},{"name":"recordId","type":"string","description":"报表内稳定记录标识"}]
